<!-- Harbor → Matrix Bridge (vulnerability webhooks) --> <mxCell id="e_harbor_bridge" edge="1" source="harbor" target="matrix_bridge" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;dashed=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="370" y="370"/> <mxPoint x="370" y="612"/> <mxPoint x="850" y="612"/> <mxPoint x="850" y="950"/> <mxPoint x="560" y="950"/> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_harbor_bridge_l" value="scan webhooks" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=8;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_harbor_bridge"> <mxGeometry x="0.5" relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
